turns.question: What was our revenue in Q3 2026?
turns.answer: Revenue (EUR) for calendar Q3 2026 (2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30) was 17,656.25 EUR, and for fiscal Q3 2026 (2026-08-01 to 2026-10-31, fiscal year starting 1 February) it was 19,793.59 EUR; tell me which quarter you meant.
